value.title: Conversation ingestion — native session stores → conversations index
value.summary: Rust-native readers for the agent-session stores (claude, omp, pij ledger, git-ai metrics-db) feeding the existing conversations import incrementally, surfaced as flowspace3 conversations ingest + a thin harness extension.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: flowspace3 gains first-class ingestion of agent conversations from the native telemetry stores (req-0027, extending the req-0024..0026 surface). Input is either (pij_id, folder) or (session_id, harness, folder). Parsers live INSIDE flowspace, in Rust (Jordan ruling 2026-08-28): four store readers behind one frozen ConversationSource trait, an incremental byte-offset cursor service, and a normalizer to the measured turn payload, composed into `flowspace3 conversations ingest` which appends iteratively through the existing idempotent import. A thin harness extension wraps the command for now; the harness later calls it natively. Extraction recipe: scratch/reconstruct/09-ingestion-recipe.md (xoxarle, verified on this machine); payload spec: scratch/conversations-telemetry-sample.md; reconvo.py is the reference oracle the Rust readers are verified against. This plan is dogfood run #1 of the pij-team pipeline (impl-guide.dd.json in this folder is binding for the decomposition).

sections.name: goals
value: Ingest any local agent conversation by pij id or native session id into the conversations index, repeatably and incrementally.
First-class Rust parsing of the git-ai/native session stores inside flowspace (no python runtime dependency).
Append-only re-polling: a second ingest run lands only new turns, driven by durable byte-offset cursors.
Prove the pij-team working model: frozen contracts, parallel SRP services, composition as wiring.

sections.name: non_goals
value: Live/streaming capture (daemon-side tailing, POST /conversations) — a later plan; this is pull-based ingest on demand.
Roll-up summaries or error promotion (v1.1, Jordan-gated).
Ingesting stores on other machines or retention management of the native stores.
Harness-native ingestion (the harness absorbs this later; v1 ships a thin extension wrapper).

value.claim: Ingest by (pij_id, folder) resolves harness + session files via the pij sessions join and lands the conversation's turns in the index.
Ingest by (session_id, harness, folder) lands the same turns as the pij-id route for the same underlying session (same content hashes).
A second ingest run after new session activity appends ONLY the new turns — byte-offset cursor proven by a live re-poll transcript.
Claude subagent sidecar files are discovered (including ones that appear mid-session) and ingested as child conversations linked to the parent.
Compaction/summary turns are preserved with a system-turn kind, never dropped, for both claude and omp stores.
A turn ingested this way is findable via flowspace3 search --source conversation after enrichment drains.
All four readers pass the shared contract suite against golden fixtures, offline, standalone (cargo test -p per crate, no daemon, no network).
harness checks green on the composed branch; every new dependency edge is a deliberate arch-allowlist row granted by the impl-guide.

value.title: Phase 1: Contracts + fixtures
value.brief: Freeze the seams before anyone is spawned (tenet 2): the ConversationSource trait (resolve(input) -> session files; read_incremental(cursor) -> raw records + new cursor), the cursor/raw-record/normalized-turn types, sanitized golden fixtures for all four stores, and the shared contract suite in testkit that every reader must pass. reconvo.py pinned as the reference oracle. Small and serial — PM-codeable per the impl-guide fan_out rules.
value.receipt: Frozen and committed at a3bbfd2. tk-c101..c105 all checked with receipts. harness checks GREEN in worktree ../fs3-convo-ingest against the sealed scratch db fs3_convo_ingest: docs, lock, testdb, fmt, clippy, prodguard before/after, cargo test --all. The frozen seam is the ConversationSource trait + its types (fs3-core), the shared contract suite and the committed oracle expectations (fs3-testkit), and tail.rs line framing written once (fs3-providers). Any change to it after this point is a defect routed to prime, not a PM refactor. No AC closes here: ac-0007 needs the four readers, ac-0003 needs the live re-poll.

value.title: Phase 2: Parallel services (readers, cursor, normalizer)
value.brief: The fan-out wave: six SRP units, each independently written and tested behind the phase-1 contracts — claude reader (per-block merge, sidecar re-glob, spilled tool-results), omp reader (xd:// remap, toolCallId pairing), pij-ledger reader (seq cursor, receipts), metrics-db reader (rowid cursor, both dialects, repo scoping), cursor-state service (inode/offset, tail buffer, rotation; PG-persisted), normalizer (raw -> measured turn payload). Zero shared files beyond one export line each; every unit ships its snap-in recipe.

value.title: Phase 3: Composition + surface
value.brief: Composition is wiring, not building: the join (pij sessions -> uuid shape routes the store), the ingest orchestrator pumping readers through cursor-state into the existing idempotent import, the `flowspace3 conversations ingest` CLI surface, the thin harness extension wrapper, and the first-light proof — ingest a REAL live session by pij id, re-poll, show the append-only delta, then find it via search.
